items.title: 13.3 Halogen molecules ke bond ki taqat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.3 with Table 13.3, printed page 294.

blocks.text: Group mein chlorine se iodine tak neeche jate hue halogens ke bond ki taqat (bond strength) kam hoti jati hai. Wajah yeh hai ke neeche jate hue atoms ka size barhta hai, is liye bond lamba (longer bond length) aur kamzor hota hai. Group 17 mein oopar se neeche bond energy chlorine se iodine tak aahista aahista kam hoti hai. Lekin fluorine is group mein exception (alag misal) hai. Fluorine ka bond nisbatan kamzor hai kyun ke fluorine ke atoms bohat chhote hain. Chhote size ki wajah se dono fluorine atoms ke lone pairs (bond mein shamil na hone wale electron jore) ek doosre ke bohat qareeb hote hain aur zor se repel (dhakelna) karte hain. Yeh repulsion bond ko kamzor kar deta hai, halan ke fluorine ki electronegativity bohat zyada hai. Halogens ki bond energies Table 13.3 mein hain.

blocks.alt: Moti lakeer wala F–F. Har F ke teen narangi lone-pair lobes hain, har ek mein do sabz nuqte: ek oopar, ek neeche aur ek bahar ki taraf. Dono oopar wale lobes aur dono neeche wale lobes ke darmiyan surkh dohre teer; oopar 'lp - lp repulsion' likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 13.1: Lone pairs ke saath F2 molecule (kitab ke safha 294 ki Figure 13.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; kitab yeh number do dafa istemal karti hai).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Fluorine ke atoms bohat chhote hain, is liye F–F bond chhota hai aur dono atoms ke lone pairs ek doosre ke bohat qareeb aa jate hain. Teer (lp–lp repulsion) dikhate hain ke yeh jore ek doosre ko dhakelte hain; yahi dhakka bond ko kamzor karta hai, is liye F₂ ki bond energy (156 kJ mol⁻¹) Cl₂ (243 kJ mol⁻¹) se kam hai.

blocks.prompt: Kaun sa halogen molecule sab se mazboot bond rakhta hai, aur F₂ ka bond Cl₂ se kamzor kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Cl₂ (243 kJ mol⁻¹). F₂ (156 kJ mol⁻¹) mein atoms bohat chhote hain, is liye dono taraf ke lone pairs bohat qareeb aa kar ek doosre ko zor se dhakelte hain aur bond kamzor ho jata hai. Chlorine ke atoms bare hain, lone pairs door rehte hain, is liye repulsion kam hai.

items: Bond energy Cl₂ (243) > Br₂ (193) > I₂ (151 kJ mol⁻¹): atoms bare, bond lamba aur kamzor.
F₂ (156) exception hai: chhote atoms ke lone pairs ka repulsion bond ko kamzor karta hai.
